integrity: The analytic derivation proves the continuum statements; a standalone checker supplies finite numerical diagnostics but is not independent validation. The full shape inversion rests on explicit endpoint density limits and cancellation of surface-area normalization.
scientific_limitations: Strictly triaxial Euclidean ellipsoids a>b>c>0 only
Exact normalized surface-area sampling; no noisy finite-sample stability theorem
Earlier eigenvalue-density literature makes the density formula a transformed known result; priority of endpoint-ratio shape inversion remains contingent on wider historical review
title: Exact reconstruction of a triaxial ellipsoid from three curvature-histogram statistics
